about.title: About Karshi International University
about.p1: Karshi International University (KIU) was founded in 2022 in the city of Karshi, Kashkadarya region. It is one of the modern centers of higher education in the Republic of Uzbekistan.
about.p2: Our goal is to prepare students for life by giving them quality education and soft skills, and to create opportunities for education, research and professional development to international standards.
